issues.issue: Was the visa officer's refusal of the study permit reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: Seeks review of the refusal; the specific arguments are not set out in the text.
issues.result_quote: Taken together they amply support the Officer’s conclusion and the outcome falls within the acceptable range in light of the circumstances.

issues.applicant_position: No proof of funds was wrongly found; father's letter and bank statement showed the expenses could be paid.
issues.result_quote: this error does not render the Officer’s conclusion unreasonable
